title: modernize-lint-orchestrator-and-dep-sync-stamp
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Our lint and test presubmit paths have accumulated bespoke scripts and many repo-level exceptions. This PR replaces legacy Gruntfile-based bootstrapping and the ad-hoc lint-runner with a compact, language-aware 'lint orchestrator' and a dependency-sync 'stamp' that records the source-of-truth lockfile snapshot used for a given presubmit run. Goals: 1) reduce presubmit startup time by consolidating initialization and parallelizing linter setup; 2) provide a lightweight dependency stamp that ties CI results to a deterministic lockfile snapshot to help triage flakes caused by transitive dep churn; 3) make lint config per-language pluggable and easier to opt teams into; 4) keep rollout safe (feature-flagged, gradual). Changes in this PR: - Add a new orchestrator binary (scripts/ci/lint_orchestrator.go) that enumerates changed files, dispatches language-specific linters, and creates a short-lived execution plan with concurrency limits tuned for ephemeral runners. - Introduce dep sync stamp (tools/dep_sync/stamp.json.template + scripts/ci/emit_dep_stamp.sh) which writes a small fingerprint (lockfile hash, package-manager, timestamp, runner-id) into build metadata. - Replace legacy grunt bootstrap in package.json -> scripts->ci:lint with a shim that invokes the orchestrator. - Split the monolithic lint job into three staged steps in .github/workflows/presubmit-lint.yml: prepare-orchestrator, run-orchestrator, collect-results; the new flow emits structured annotations to GitHub checks and uploads a small per-run artifact with the dep stamp. - Add light backward compatibility: if orchestrator not available, runner falls back to previous node-based lint entrypoint for two-week grace window. - Update docs: docs/ci/lint-orchestrator.md describes opt-in, environment variables, and telemetry. - Add unit and integration tests for orchestrator dispatch logic (test/lint_orchestrator_test.go) and small e2e smoke job in tools/ci-smoke/ that runs orchestrator against a synthetic workspace. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed in ENG-2871. - [x] Unit tests added. - [x] Integration smoke added and green locally. - [x] Feature gated via CI env var LINT_ORCH_ENABLED. - [x] Rollout plan added to PR body. Rollout plan: enable LINT_ORCH_ENABLED=false by default; flip to true for team/rust and team/js canaries for one week; monitor flaky lint failures and dep-stamp mismatches via an introduced metric (ci.dep_stamp.mismatch). If any regressions are observed, flip feature off and revert via a small hotfix. Related: ENG-2899 coordinates the dep-stamp ingestion into internal flakiness dashboard. Security notes: orchestrator does not change credential handling; dep stamp contains no secrets, only lockfile hash and meta fields. Testing and validation performed: CI smoke on ephemeral runner (simulated slow network) showed 22% median presubmit latency decrease on JS-heavy changes and 11% on mixed-language changes. The stamp was used to correlate one flaky eslint plugin upgrade to a transient registry mirror issue during the canary. See commits for iteration history. CI: initial run failed due to path assumptions on Windows runners (fixed in commit 3), final pipeline green. Merge notes: squash-merged to main after approvals and CI green.
commits: 1) scaffold: add lint_orchestrator.go with dispatcher interface and concurrency config
2) feat: emit dep stamp from orchestrator and add stamp template
3) fix(ci): handle windows path join and use consistent tmpdir across OS
4) ci(workflows): split presubmit-lint job into prepare/run/collect stages
5) docs: add docs/ci/lint-orchestrator.md and rollout plan
6) test: add unit tests for matching changed-file->linter rules
7) chore: shim package.json ci:lint -> calls orchestrator if enabled
8) ci: add smoke e2e runner and update workflow artifact uploads
reviews: Daniel Koh (reviewer): Nice consolidation. Two nits: (1) can you expose concurrency via env var with sane max to allow teams to opt-down? (2) please add comments on error cases where we continue vs fail the job.
Priya Nair (author): Responded: both addressed — added LINT_ORCH_MAX_CONCURRENCY default=6 and added detailed error handling docstrings; updated unit tests to cover non-fatal linter crash.
Marisol Vega (reviewer): Approved after second pass. Left note about telemetry labels to help filter canaries from production runs.
Ethan Moran (reviewer): Asked for a short compatibility window and a one-line revert playbook in the PR body.
Priya Nair (author): Added revert playbook and two-week compatibility shim; confirmed rollback steps in docs/ci/lint-orchestrator.md
merge: squash-merge by Priya Nair: merged into main. Short SHA: a7c4d9e
release_notes: Introduce a language-aware lint orchestrator and a dep-sync 'stamp' for deterministic CI provenance. Reduces presubmit latency, adds dependency fingerprinting to help triage flakiness. Backwards compatible via two-week shim. No user-facing API changes.
notes: Operational follow-ups: add ci.dep_stamp.mismatch alert to SRE runbook (tracked ENG-2932). We will also schedule a 1-week post-rollout audit to ensure no increase in false positives from new orchestrator rules.
